name: SMB Enumeration
description: Ability to enumerate Windows and Samba file-sharing services using SMB/CIFS protocols. Covers share enumeration, user and group listing, session enumeration, null session exploitation, and extraction of security policy information from SMB services.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to SMB enumeration techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands SMB protocol basics and why SMB enumeration is valuable in engagements
evidence: Can explain the SMB/CIFS protocol and its common ports (445, 139)
Understands concepts of shares, sessions, and null sessions
Knows the security implications of exposed SMB services

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic SMB enumeration under supervision using standard tools
evidence: Uses smbclient, enum4linux, or NetExec to list shares
Enumerates users and groups via null sessions when available
Identifies accessible shares and their permissions under guidance
Documents SMB findings in engagement notes under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs comprehensive SMB enumeration and identifies security weaknesses
evidence: Systematically enumerates shares, users, groups, and policies across networks
Identifies sensitive data in accessible shares (credentials, configs, PII)
Detects SMB signing configuration and relay attack opportunities
Integrates SMB findings into the broader engagement attack path

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex SMB environments; automates enumeration workflows; mentors others
evidence: Enumerates large Active Directory environments with thousands of shares
Develops automated SMB enumeration scripts for engagement efficiency
Identifies non-obvious information leakage through SMB metadata
Mentors junior staff on SMB enumeration methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines SMB enumeration methodology; develops tools; trains teams on advanced techniques
evidence: Authored the lab's SMB enumeration standard methodology
Develops or contributes to SMB enumeration tools
Deep understanding of SMB protocol internals and dialect negotiation
Trains teams on advanced SMB enumeration and attack surface analysis

assessment_methods.description: Enumerate all shares, users, and accessible data on a lab Windows domain environment with mixed SMB configurations
Review SMB enumeration findings from a recent engagement for completeness and accuracy
